_meta.description: Subset of the IANA Language Subtag Registry: only the subtags needed to validate the nine configured languages, their scripts, and the regions IN, US, GB. Task P1-03. This is a SUBSET, not a full registry; it cannot validate arbitrary provider-observed tags (see docs/languages.md).
_meta.verification: Verified 2026-10-22 by direct download of the IANA registry (File-Date 2026-09-17) and a script comparison of all 20 records (type, subtag, description, added, suppress-script): no mismatches. This supersedes the retrieval_method note below.

sources.license_note: IANA registry data is in the public domain per IANA; not re-checked here.

_meta.retrieval_method: Originally transcribed from model-processed web-fetch output (not a byte-exact download). Verified 2026-10-22 against directly downloaded primary sources by scripts/verify_language_data.py: 0 mismatches, except the documented KMF trailing-space allowance in the ISO 4217 names.
_meta.record_fields: Fields mirror the registry record fields; description is a list because a record may carry several Description lines in order.

records.comments: as of 2006-03-29 GB no longer includes the Channel Islands and Isle of Man; see GG, JE, IM
